verdicts.quote: A new account's schedule shows five steps at -3, 0, +7, +14 and +30 days relative to the due date.

Open or Partially paid whose balance is above zero receives reminders. … After a payment, credit note, void or write-off brings an invoice to any of those, no further reminder is sent … while a dispute is settled
verdicts.missing: Whether a dispute or an active payment plan itself suspends reminders. U-7 describes pausing a disputed invoice by hand.

verdicts.quote: An invoice of 1,000.00 USD with 400.00 USD paid shows 600.00 USD in the reminder.
A suppressed address receives no reminders from any invoice in the account, automatic or manual … the invoice is paused; the invoice is stopped by the recipient
verdicts.missing: How an existing customer-wide do-not-contact, pause or unsubscribe affects billing reminders, including whether a marketing opt-out applies.

verdicts.quote: When two sending runs overlap or the same step is processed twice, the customer still receives it once … A sending run cut short by a platform time limit, crash or restart loses no due reminder and duplicates none
Immediately before every attempt, including retries and manual sends, the system re-checks these conditions and sends nothing if any holds: the invoice is settled
A transient delivery failure is retried up to 3 times, at least 15 minutes apart, and only on the same calendar day … the entry shows Failed and no further attempt is made for that step.
verdicts.missing: Whether a person is alerted when retries are exhausted, who receives the alert, and when. U-9 provides a list an Admin can check.

verdicts.quote: When more than 1,000 reminders are due for one account at one send time, all are handed to the mail provider as fast as the provider's rate allows … The provider's rate limit figure is unconfirmed.
verdicts.missing: The provider quota, including how many messages may be sent per time interval.

verdicts.quote: Nothing goes out to customers on the day for steps dated that day or earlier; overdue invoices receive their next step that is dated after the day of enabling.
without shifting for weekends or holidays … The send time is a whole hour of the day in the account's time zone, defaulting to 09:00 … The send time can be set to any of 00:00, 01:00 ... 23:00
Amounts are shown in the invoice's own currency with that currency's standard number of decimal places

zero billing addresses, or an address that is not a syntactically valid email address, no email is sent to that address … A permanent delivery failure for an address is recorded as Bounced and not retried
Reminders go to at most the first 5 billing addresses of an invoice, in the order the invoice lists them

recorded in that invoice's history … one row per attempted step and billing address … Each row shows origin (the step's offset or manual), the date it was scheduled for, the time of each attempt and its status.
invoice number; outstanding balance with its currency; due date … the account's payment instructions; the customer-facing link to view the invoice when the invoice has one
verdicts.missing: Whether the customer-facing invoice link expires and, if so, when.

verdicts.quote: Only an Owner or Admin of the account can use these controls: turn reminders On or Off, edit the schedule … pause or resume an invoice, send a reminder now
The operator can stop all reminder sending system-wide … turn reminders On or Off … send a test, pause or resume an invoice, send a reminder now
verdicts.missing: How to disable reminders for one customer across all of that customer's invoices.

verdicts.quote: Scheduled with the date of the next reminder … a list of invoices whose reminders failed, bounced, had no recipient address, had an unknown outcome or were held back by a suppressed address
A due step that is more than 3 calendar days past its date in the account's time zone is not sent

Reminder activity never changes an invoice's state, balance, due date, addresses or any other invoice data … An invoice can be created, issued and paid with reminders Off exactly as before the feature existed.
